plans.heading: EXT. HILLSIDE ABOVE THE LAKE - LATE AFTERNOON

cameras.what: Gate plate: outside the gate, looking in
Turned right: the wall to the lake, the grove
Board turned left: the leaf, the wall uphill
Olive view: uphill inside the wall

notes: 1, the gate plate (image_gen, 3:2): stands 6 m outside the gateway at (33, 0), faces 180°; the gate, the olive and ledge 33 m beyond, the lake on the RIGHT; sun ahead-right.
2, the olive view (image_edit from 1): stands uphill inside the wall at (-2, -11), faces 60°; the olive and ledge on the left, the gate 31 m off on the right, the lake beyond; sun from the left.
3, turned right (image_edit from 1): the same spot as 1, faces 90°; the wall running down to the lake on the left, the grove on the right; sun ahead-left.
The board's reverse (R) faces 0° into the grove, lit from behind; turned left (L) faces 270°, the open leaf close on the right, the wall climbing the hill.
Grid: +x toward the gate (screen right), +y downhill to the lake (screen top); the seat and ledge at (0, 0), the gate at (27, 0); metres, not compass.
